newsitem.title: FINLAND: KYRO WINS FIM 50 MILLION ORDER FROM TELE DANMARK.
newsitem.headline: KYRO WINS FIM 50 MILLION ORDER FROM TELE DANMARK.

text.p: Finnish machinery and power company Kyro Oy said in a statement on Thursday its Tecnomen unit had won a pager systems order worth 50 million markka from Tele Danmark Mobil A/S for ERMES paging services in Denmark and Sweden.
"The deal, the value of which is a good 50 million markka, includes an answering service and hundreds of HiQ 1,000 base station deliveries to the systems," Kyro said.
Kyro said Tecnomen's systems are used in over 50 countries and that it has been cooperating with Tele Danmark for long.
Kyro has said it expects a listing on the Helsinki stock exchange to start around June 9. Its initial public offering of 8.18 million shares earlier this month was clearly oversubcribed.
